the author's own proof environment immediately following the lemma: Deduce the forward direction from functoriality of properness under base change, and for the converse work affine locally on the base, refine the h covering to a single proper surjective morphism from a scheme with an open covering whose members carry the properness, transfer properness of the pulled back cycle to properness over the base of the closure of the inverse image of the support using the support compatibility under the pullback, propagate properness along the proper covering morphism by transitivity, and conclude that the image of that closure, a closed subset proper over the base containing the support, forces the cycle to be proper (source lines 2136-2155)
